mainEntity.name: What Is the Difference Between a Dedicated Palletizing Cell and a Centralized Multi-Line System?

acceptedAnswer.text: A dedicated cell palletizes the output of one production line, so each line runs on its own. A centralized multi-line system brings several lines into one palletizing area, which changes the conveying, accumulation and pallet handling around it. TRFSpeed is configurable and modular, so it scales from a dedicated cell to a centralized system serving multiple lines.

mainEntity.name: What Is Slip Sheet Palletizing and When Is It Needed?

acceptedAnswer.text: Slip sheet palletizing places a thin sheet between layers or under the load. Plants use slip sheets when a pallet load needs more stability or protection, or when their own customers require them. Slip sheet handling is one of the TRFSpeed options, alongside multipick, automatic pallet handling and pallet discharge.
